source_refs.title: If your iPhone or iPod touch won't charge - Apple Support (CA)
source_refs.section: Steps for an iPhone that won't charge or charges slowly
source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPod touch that won't charge or charges slowly
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Your iPhone might get slightly warmer while it charges.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Plug the iPhone into a computer, a power accessory, or a wall outlet. Restart the iPhone. Check the charging cable and USB adapter for damage, such as breaks or bent prongs. Stop using any damaged accessory. Use a wall outlet, confirm that the cable, USB adapter, and outlet connect securely, or try a different outlet. Clear debris from the charging port on the bottom of the iPhone, then firmly plug in the cable. Charge for about 30 minutes.

source_refs.title: If your iPhone or iPod touch won't charge - Apple Support (CA)
source_refs.section: Steps for an iPhone that won't charge or charges slowly, force restart
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; the force restart applies only if the iPhone still won't turn on or shows a battery icon on the screen
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Your iPhone might get slightly warmer while it charges.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Only if the iPhone still won't turn on or shows a battery icon on the screen, force a restart. On iPhone 8 or later and iPhone SE (2nd generation or later): Quickly press volume up, quickly press volume down, then press and hold the side button until the Apple logo appears. On iPhone 7 or iPhone 7 Plus: Press and hold the side (or top) button and volume down until the Apple logo appears. On iPhone 6s or earlier and iPhone SE (1st generation): Press and hold the side (or top) button and the Home button until the Apple logo appears. Then charge for another 30 minutes. If the iPhone still won't turn on or charge, you may need service through the 'Get service' link.

source_refs.title: Fix a Pixel phone that won't charge or turn on - Pixel Phone Help
source_refs.section: Troubleshoot case, battery charger, cable & outlet, remove the case and test the wireless charger
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Remove your phone case to ensure that it doesn’t interfere with your charging plug or wireless charger.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Pixel phones: Take off any case that could block the wired plug or wireless charger. Use a wired plug for the best charging performance. Use a wireless charger approved for your specific Pixel model.

source_refs.section: Troubleshoot case, battery charger, cable & outlet, test the adapter, cable and outlet
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Remove your phone case to ensure that it doesn’t interfere with your charging plug or wireless charger.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Pixel phones: Charge another device with the same adapter and cable. Make sure the cable is firmly seated at both ends, clear any dust or lint from the phone's port, and try a different cable or adapter. Plug the charger into a wall outlet and confirm it works by powering something else, like a lamp. Make sure no cases or battery packs cover the phone's sensors or buttons.

source_refs.section: Troubleshoot case, battery charger, cable & outlet, Charge for 10 minutes
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Remove your phone case to ensure that it doesn’t interfere with your charging plug or wireless charger.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Pixel phones: Connect the phone with a working cable, charger, and outlet, then wait one minute.
